summary: Verified admin access flows end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (admin login returns role=admin via /api/auth/me, /api/admin/qa/summary + /api/admin/qa/questions?quality=flagged return 200, non-admin correctly gets 403 on admin QA endpoints, chansons category+questions still 200). Frontend: /app/admin loads with title 'Tableau de bord' and all 4 tiles visible (admin-tile-analytics/promo/reports/qa); AdminDropdown (nav-admin-trigger) opens and exposes all 5 links (home/analytics/promo/reports/qa); /app/admin/qa shows title 'Qualité IA · Modération', 9 category summary cards, filter defaults to 'flagged', 117 flagged questions listed with fact-check comments. Non-admin registered user is correctly redirected from /app/admin to /app/dashboard. Regression on /app/quiz/chansons OK: quiz-pool-info shows '48/53 nouvelles questions à découvrir' and Q1 renders correctly. No blank page, no unexpected redirect for admin — the reported access issue is NOT reproducible with the current admin credentials.
action_items: Original user report ('cannot access /app/admin') is not reproducible in current state. Likely causes: (a) user tried old password Admin2026! (rotated), (b) stale session cookie without admin role — a re-login fixes it, or (c) user typed /app/admin without logging in first and was sent to /login. Consider a small UX note on login page for admins after password rotation.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminRoute logic in /app/frontend/src/App.js is correct: loading state handled, unauthenticated -> /login, non-admin -> /app/dashboard.
Admin QA summary payload appears to be an object with 9 category keys — UI renders 9 tiles correctly.
